events.verdict: Eason (HOU) jumps from point A to point B and initiates contact with Garland (CLE) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) briefly grasps Mobley's (CLE) jersey off ball.
Mobley (CLE) brings his hand forward towards Sengun's (HOU) front as he begins his drive to the basket, and the contact is marginal.
Niang (CLE) cleanly deflects the ball away from Thompson (HOU).
Sengun (HOU) briefly grasps Niang's (CLE) arm off ball, and he immediately releases him as the post entry pass is being delivered.
Niang (CLE) initiates contact with Sengun's (HOU) body that affects his shot near the rim.
Sengun (HOU) cleanly deflects the ball away from Mitchell (CLE) as they pursue the rebound.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Mobley (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.

As Sengun (HOU) and Mobley (CLE) engage for positioning, Sengun's forearm makes marginal contact with Mobley's head/face during the inbound.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Mobley (CLE) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Mobley (CLE) moves alongside Sengun's (HOU) path and maintains a legal guarding position as he defends the post shot.
Mobley (CLE) establishes himself in Brooks' (HOU) path and he absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Brooks (HOU) extends his right hand and makes contact with Mitchell's (CLE) arm, and the contact affects his jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) establishes himself in Strus' (CLE) path and he absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Sengun (HOU) and Niang (CLE) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Mobley (CLE) is drawn into the air on the pump fake by Thompson (HOU), and delivers body contact that affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Mobley (CLE) establishes himself in a screening position in Thompson's (HOU) path and does not deliver contact.
Mitchell (CLE) steps forward into VanVleet's (HOU) space and initiates body to body contact on ball.

Strus (CLE) extends his right hand and makes more than marginal contact to Green's (HOU) upper body.  While the contact occurs prior to Green's gather, the Cavaliers are over the foul limit and free throws would be shot regardless.
Niang (CLE) moves forward into Thompson's (HOU) space and delivers body to body contact that affects his SQBR.
Mitchell (CLE) commits a take foul on Thompson (HOU).
